reviews.body: Clean fix for a real logging bug — the stdlib logging module uses %-style placeholders, so the old {} format strings never interpolated the exception text. The two changed lines are correct, and the new test file properly covers both failure paths by mocking the DB, driving _batch_loop, and asserting the exception text lands in logs. Ready to merge.

review_comments.body: Consider naming this helper _run_one_iteration instead of _run_loop_once — the double-sleep-and-abort trick runs the body once but technically invokes the loop twice (once for the first sleep, once to hit _StopLoop). The current name reads as "run the loop exactly one time" when it's really "run the body once, aborting before the second iteration." Non-blocking nit; the test logic is sound either way.

Does get_app need to be mocked here? In the record-insertion test (line 41) you only mock the DB and queue, but here you also mock get_app. If it's required to prevent a real lookup or AttributeError, consider adding a comment explaining why — otherwise readers might wonder if it's dead code or whether the other test is missing something.
